title: Constant quotient completion unit on every complex
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on a small category, A a commutative ring, I an ideal and b the choice of coefficient presentation in [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. For every cochain complex P over these coefficients, its specified constant quotient-completion unit followed by derived inverse limit of the quotient presentation comparison equals localization of its ordinary strict quotient-limit unit followed by the universal inverse-limit comparison. No K-flat hypothesis on P is required.

source.place: current order 1316, Koszul-to-quotient comparison, including its unit equation

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution f:K to P. The prescribed quotient completion normalization gives the equation for K.

The ordinary strict-limit unit is natural for every chain map: compose the two candidate naturality maps with every finite projection and use the naturality of the strict quotient augmentation; joint monicity proves equality.

Precompose the desired equation for P with Q(f), an isomorphism. Naturality of the completion unit, of the quotient comparison, of the ordinary quotient unit and of the inverse-limit comparison transports the equation from K to P. Cancel Q(f).

proof_origin.place: Formal comparison and unit-normalization details of the recorded Koszul/quotient reconstruction; proved from the existing universal and reflector interfaces.

lean.statement:
theorem constantCompletionUnit_normalization_all
    {C : Type t} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (A : Type t) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (b : Bool)
    (P : ConstantCompletion.Cx (ConstantCompletion.coefficients J A I b)) :
    (ConstantCompletion.completionUnit J A I b).app
        ((ConstantCompletion.Q (ConstantCompletion.coefficients J A I b)).obj P) ≫
      (ConstantCompletion.rlim (ConstantCompletion.coefficients J A I b)).map
        ((ConstantCompletion.quotientPresentation J A I b).comparison.app P) =
      (ConstantCompletion.Q (ConstantCompletion.coefficients J A I b)).map
        (ConstantCompletion.ordinaryUnit J A I b P) ≫
        (ConstantCompletion.limitComparison (ConstantCompletion.coefficients J A I b)).app
          (ConstantCompletion.reductionComplex J A I b P)
